gradual_evolution.targets: fresh + nine full signed mature closed cuboid parameter profiles

dark_run_path_070.scope: Ordinary living Dark adult with locked RUN FIRST evolution; full signed later axes including opposite Power.
dark_run_path_070.reference: Fresh actual Chao Island green Run FIRST checkbox, full Dark alignment and actual age/axis/orbit controls verified. Model author personally inspected young/balanced front/side/back, mature Run/Power front/side and all nine mature side sources before authoring. Source confirms three large rear points plus two separate front-side nubs.
dark_run_path_070.approximation: Exact original square skull retained. Eight closed cuboids provide one two-section central swept crest, a two-section rear quill on each side and two independent front-side nubs. Balanced raises the central end; Run lengthens and broadens back/up quills; Power raises the central stalk and lowers thin side ends; Fly flattens its swept crest and nubs; Swim lowers broad quills and small nubs. Four compatible mixed corners retain distinct shapes. Smooth rising skull mass, tapered horns, hooked tips and rounded nub lobes are simplified. Linear age/bilinear training approximates source timing.
dark_run_path_070.paint_policy: Only central root/tip face4 local-negativeY receives two-region longitudinal top-spine pigment. Rear quills receive pigment on their physical outer lateral faces; nubs have a small front inset and top cap. No forehead geometry or decorative bands are added. Original face UVs remain exact.
dark_run_path_070.wing_policy: Three opaque closed cuboid rays approximate each observed compact two-lobed bat membrane on the original joint. Fixed ray directions preserve exact proximal hinges. Fly broadens the fan, Power stays compact. The current Dark Fly world-orientation and late-floor posture fit is reused through a scoped sibling predicate, on the existing production clock.
dark_run_path_070.numeric_visibility_refinement: Actual emitted upright sampling across all27 age/axis states found Power and PowerSwim fans too close to their broader torsos. Their authored ray spans increase2.50to2.95 and2.65to3.00 respectively; other seven mature targets, fresh geometry, original hinges and poses remain unchanged. The existing .7modelpixel visibility guard and every collision/continuity limit are retained. Source back views establish compact Power fans relative to the broad Fly fan; obscured torso outlines do not establish an exact balanced-versus-Power ratio.
dark_run_path_070.body_contact_policy: Torso top extends .45modelpixels for existing scoped walking lift; wrists keep original upper plane, soles/heels fixed. Limbs retain compact boxes; no intended head-feature contact with torso, hands, wings, feet or tail.
dark_run_path_070.front_nub_policy: Two separately authored closed blocks remain above and outside the eyes, positively embedded in the original upper head. They develop taller in Run, flatter/backward in Fly and shorter/rounder in Swim. They are never merged with rear quills.
dark_run_path_070.marker_policy: Original dot core and expression joints/visibility exact; six same-bone closed protrusions interpret the observed Dark spiked ball.
dark_run_path_070.tail_policy: Two slim connected closed boxes retain the original tail base and joint; scoped prone folding pivots about an interior point of the unchanged base.
dark_run_path_070.provisional_rates: 960current level-bar progress per opposing axis, independent adult maturity. Viewer establishes no original-game level or morph formula.
